comparison_boundary: External experience, not an apples-to-apples denominator. The active historical-ruler reproduction matches the no-prefix-cache versus Hypic-only question but uses Qwen3.6-27B, TP4, four 910B4 cards and the current image instead of Qwen3.5-27B, TP2 and two 910C cards. The completed PDC+Hypic versus PDC-only experiment is a separate question. Compare direction and relative deltas only; never pool absolute latency, throughput or quality.
